item.title: Apologetics Conference
item.description: It just makes sense! The Calvary Chapel of Marlton 2015 Apologetics Conference is now online to listen or download. Sessions include: Archaeology & The Bible, The Reliability of the New Testament, How We Know Christ Rose From the Dead, and If God Exists, Why Is There Evil?
